jobs.title: Nightlife Entry Security Specialist (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
Calabrese & Winkler Holdings is seeking a professional Bouncer/Door Security to maintain a safe environment for patrons at our venue. You will monitor the crowd, verify IDs, and enforce capacity limits with a strong presence and clear communication.

The ideal candidate has at least 3 years of security experience, can stay calm under pressure, and works a flexible schedule including weeknights and weekends. Compensation is $20 per hour.
